data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 清晨被窝
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 樱岛麻衣 · 清晨被窝】二十岁以上成年后的麻衣独自在晨光镀金的大床上醒来。宽大白衬衫只扣住下摆，她抱膝坐在枕堆间，把一只手从衣摆下探向腿间，另一手揉着惺忪眼角；凌乱黑发铺在肩头，呼吸让敞开的前襟轻轻起伏。她带着刚睡醒的红晕呢喃——「再给我五分钟……这段晨戏，谁也不许来打扰。」
data.lighting: pale morning light through sheer curtains
data.promptProse: Morning sunbeams find adult, age-twenty-plus Mai Sakurajima among pillows with both knees drawn up. A white shirt is fastened only at the hem, framing bare breasts as one hand slips beneath it between her thighs and the other rubs sleep from a violet eye. Tousled black hair clings to her collarbone while soft sheets anchor the folded pose. Her drowsy expression shifts into a knowing blush without another figure entering the room. Intimate seated medium shot, one adult woman, no text.
data.nsfwProse: Around the near pillow seam, white linen overlaps a folded blanket; a book and water glass rest separately on the bedside shelf. Pale morning light enters from the left through a sheer curtain, laying soft bands over the pillow corners and shelf edge. The far upholstered headboard stays gently shaded. Mai Sakurajima is an adult woman, age twenty or older.
